theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_ret_nc_local_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (Φ : X → Y) (U : Set X) (z₀ : X) (Λ : X ≃L[ℝ] Y), IsOpen U → z₀ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ U → HasFDerivAt Φ (Λ : X →L[ℝ] Y) z₀ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball z₀ ρ ⊆ U ∧ ∃ G : Y → X, (∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ρ, G (Φ z) = z) ∧ ∀ W : Set X, W ⊆ ball z₀ ρ → IsOpen W → IsOpen (Φ '' W) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (Φ '' W)
